title: Model magic item charge, recharge, and use economies
description:
Scope:
- Add typed projections for charges, maximum charges, expenditure costs, recharge timing, recharge dice/formulas, depletion/destruction clauses, command words, and per-day/use limits.
- Fable explicitly called out charge/recharge prose as a remaining deterministic gap.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory all magic items with charges/recharge/use economies.
- Model representative items with "regains 1d6 + 1" and similar recharge formulas.
- Add tests that deterministic tools can inspect charges and recharge without parsing prose.
notes:
Exact worklist now exists (2026-07-06): the C1 tags in the 18.7.7.3 inventory artifact (PR #407) — 105 of 240 items carry C1 clauses. Hard economy cases named there: boots-of-speed cumulative 10-min budget, winged-boots 4h/12h-regain pool, candle-of-invocation burn-minutes, goat-of-traveling 24 hour-charges, last-charge-d20 destruction rolls (wands/staffs), no-recharge depleting items (luck-blade wish, ring-of-three-wishes, nine-lives-stealer). Implement against the shared state contract (PR #408): pack-side useEconomy block + tool-enforced live state; reset events engine-driven (F5/F7). Do not count an item done here if it has non-C1 clauses (split-owner rule).
PR #408 final contract (7090d6c): this bead owns the keyed multi-economy pack schema (economies: Record<EconomyId, ItemEconomy> — NOT the earlier singular useEconomy) plus the operations list binding costs to stable economy ids, importer projection of charge/per-day/cooldown/budget/dose data, and economy live-state transitions over the parent-owned item_state/use_item surface. Golden cases: staff-of-fire (shared pool), rod-of-lordly-might (3 independent 1/dawn pools), staff-of-thunder-and-lightning (doesNotExpend combined use), winged-boots (budget + onlyIfUnused regain). Reset events come from F5/F7 bus, not this bead.
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Model economies as source-grounded pack semantics plus operation/economy ids and F5/F7 hook bindings. Do not treat a recharge/reset/live-counter implementation as compiler-owned unless the runtime owner is explicitly in this bead's accepted scope; otherwise leave the clause represented but engine-pending with the owning family named.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
